newsitem.title: UK: SNOOKER-EBDON CRASHES OUT AGAINST QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SNOOKER-EBDON CRASHES OUT AGAINST QUALIFIER.

text.p: Third seed Peter Ebdon crashed out of the world snooker championship on Sunday, falling 10-3 to English qualifier Stefan Mazrocis.
A beaten finalist last year, Ebdon trailed 6-2 at the start of the day and showed little resistance to bow out against Mazrocis, rated a 250-1 chance by bookmakers before the tournament.

Englishman Ebdon rarely showed the touches which carried him to last year's final against Stephen Hendry, striking only one half-century break. Mazrocis's best effort came in the fourth frame when he managed a 77.
Mazrocis, whose father emigrated from Latvia, will meet Alain Robidoux of Canada or England's Brian Morgan in the last 16.
In another upset, Welshman Lee Walker beat world number 11 Dave Harold of England 10-7.
Former world champion Terry Griffiths fell 10-9 to fellow Welshman Mark Williams in the other completed first round match.
World number nine Darren Morgan of Wales started strongly against England's Gary Wilkinson racing to a 5-1 lead. He made a competition best break of 128 along the way.
Wilkinson hit back in the final three frames to trail 5-4 at the end of the day.
